scenes.narration: What if you woke up tomorrow with the power to freeze time for 24 hours?
scenes.speaker: speaker_1
scenes.video_prompt: 24mm anamorphic wide angle shot, low-angle perspective, young man in dark charcoal hoodie stepping forward through a frozen city avenue, hand outstretched in extreme foreshortening, suspended raindrops floating in mid-air, levitating yellow cabs, shattered glowing cyan clock in sky, Unreal Engine 5 render, ray-traced volumetric lighting, 8k vertical 9:16
scenes.visual_prompt: 24mm anamorphic wide angle shot of young man in dark hoodie stepping through frozen city with floating raindrops and glowing clock, 8k
scenes.title: Beat #1

scenes.narration: At first, it feels like the ultimate playground: floating raindrops, frozen traffic, and complete silence in the city.
scenes.speaker: speaker_1
scenes.video_prompt: 10mm ultra-wide lens tracking pan, young man walking calmly past frozen pedestrians stuck mid-stride on urban sidewalk, a cup of coffee suspended mid-spill with floating liquid droplets, dramatic depth, Unreal Engine 5 cinematic render, glowing blue rim light, 8k vertical 9:16
scenes.visual_prompt: 10mm ultra-wide lens tracking pan of young man walking past frozen pedestrians with floating coffee droplets, 8k
scenes.title: Beat #2

scenes.narration: Within ten seconds, sheer terror sets in. Light photons stop moving, instantly plunging your vision into pitch-black darkness.
scenes.speaker: speaker_1
scenes.video_prompt: 35mm prime lens macro close-up, young man reacting with wide eyes in shock, reaching upward with trembling hands as pitch darkness creeps across his face, light beams freezing like solid luminescent glass rods, volumetric cyan lighting, ray tracing, 8k vertical 9:16
scenes.visual_prompt: 35mm prime lens close up of young man reacting in shock reaching upward as darkness creeps across face, 8k
scenes.title: Beat #3

scenes.narration: Oxygen molecules freeze in place like solid glass, meaning your lungs cannot pull a single breath of air.
scenes.speaker: speaker_1
scenes.video_prompt: 50mm cinema lens medium shot, young man clutching throat gasping for breath, glowing blue frost crystals forming around mouth as frozen air resists inhalation, collapsing to one knee on frozen asphalt street, shattered temporal clock above, Unreal Engine 5 render, 8k vertical 9:16
scenes.visual_prompt: 50mm cinema lens medium shot of young man clutching throat collapsing to one knee on frozen street, 8k
scenes.title: Beat #4

scenes.narration: The colossal temporal clock in the sky shatters violently, proving that freezing time won't make you a god—it will erase you.
scenes.speaker: speaker_1
scenes.video_prompt: 10mm wide-angle epic scope pull-back shot, giant shattered Roman-numeral clock in the sky vibrating violently, clock hands fracturing into blinding cyan sparks, temporal shockwaves sweeping across the frozen city, cinematic masterpiece, Unreal Engine 5 render, 8k vertical 9:16
scenes.visual_prompt: 10mm wide-angle pull-back shot of giant shattered clock in sky vibrating and fracturing into sparks over frozen city, 8k
scenes.title: Beat #5
